brief.title_es: Todo empieza con un problema real
brief.title_en: It starts with a real problem
brief.body_es: Antes de tocar nada, entender el negocio: qué duele, qué cuesta dinero y qué se puede dejar de hacer a mano.
brief.body_en: Before touching anything: understand the business, what hurts, what costs money and what should stop being manual.

system.motion: slow forward camera glide down the hall, documents sliding along the overhead rails, fog rolling, shaft of light, black and white, film grain, no cuts
system.body_es: ERP a medida sobre Odoo: ventas, inventario, contabilidad y TPV hablando entre sí, sin hojas de cálculo paralelas.
system.body_en: Custom Odoo ERP: sales, inventory, accounting and POS talking to each other, no parallel spreadsheets.

agents.motion: slow lateral camera move past the grid of glowing screens, screens pulsing softly, dust in the beams, reflections moving on the wet floor, black and white, film grain, no cuts
agents.body_es: Agentes sobre modelos locales que clasifican, redactan, revisan y avisan. Cero datos fuera de casa.
agents.body_en: Agents on local models that classify, draft, review and alert. No data leaves the building.

automation.body_en: Workflows, integrations and rules: what used to be copy-paste now happens with no human in the loop.

workshop.body_en: OdooClaw, MCP and published extensions: the work is shared, audited and reused.

finale.body_en: Free 30-minute diagnosis: tell me the bottleneck, I tell you what to automate and what is not worth it.
